title: Vacancies
lead: A published vacancy is visible to every candidate of the specialization. An application shows you the contacts at once and does not use the invitation budget.
needCompany: Vacancies are published by a company: fill in its profile first so candidates see whose vacancy it is.

published.title: No published vacancies
published.text: Describe the position and set a salary range, and candidates of the specialization will see it in their list.

archived.title: No withdrawn vacancies
archived.text: Vacancies you withdraw from publication end up here. Their applications are kept.

drawerLead: Candidates see the position, category, format and salary range. The description is shown as is.

fields.title: Position
fields.titlePlaceholder: For example, backend developer for the payments team
fields.descriptionHint: Tasks, team, conditions. Candidates decide based on this text.

errors.title: Enter the position.
errors.salary: A salary range is required: both bounds above zero, “from” not above “to”.

archive.title: Withdraw the vacancy?
archive.text: The vacancy leaves the public list and nobody can apply to it. Submitted applications stay. Publication cannot be restored.
